title: The verse locations (drowned shrine, watchtower, eastern ash wood) were never explored—game communicated them clearly but the crown path was more direct; both paths seem viable

evidence.quote: The verse locations (drowned shrine, watchtower, eastern ash wood) were never explored—game communicated them clearly but the crown path was more direct; both paths seem viable
